result.brief: 提出以生成模型条件预测的信息差估计PMI的自监督表征学习，作为生成建模的tokenizer，避免维度坍缩与特征抑制，并给出tokenizer与生成模型联合算力最优的缩放规律。
result.reason: Self-supervised representation learning used as generative tokenizer, with PMI-based objective, scaling laws, and comparison to DINO/LeJEPA; directly a representation/tokenizer contribution.
